parent: 黎明書局 / 中文館藏
purpose: 先把目前已通過 admission 的中文作品收斂成單一館藏帳本，再進入即時中文閱讀層工程。避免 queue、legacy source pool、Bible-world 中文資料和 canonical 中文作品混算。

canonicalBatches.source: Christian Literature Society for China Collection / Yale Divinity Library + Hong Kong Baptist University Library
canonicalBatches.rights: works published in 1930 or earlier admitted under the source collection's stated public-domain boundary

additionalCanonicalWorks.title: 靈歷集光
additionalCanonicalWorks.author: 宋尚節
additionalCanonicalWorks.dedupeRule: Do not duplicate if later recovered from Yale or another catalogue; attach alternate source/edition relation instead.

countSemantics: 46 CLSC canonical works plus 靈歷集光 as an independent Chinese work identity. This is a conservative confirmed floor, not the size of the full legacy Chinese source pool.
notCountedYet: CLSC 1931-1962 items that have not passed item-level rights/admission
Free Methodist Taiwan monographs and serials
bibleWorldBoundary: Bible text, commentary, Bible人物/故事、聖經地理/地圖/路線及其他查經/reference resources remain in bible-world-zh and are not counted in 黎明書局中文館藏。
nextAfterAdmissionConsolidation: Build the instant Chinese reading layer as a reader capability over canonical source works. Translation output must remain a reading layer, not inflate 中文館藏 work counts.
